svg.aria-label: How Intern runs a task on three models. A decision model sits between every turn: it searches and reranks code and files, prunes the context, picks the hand-over moment and filters tool output. Your task goes to the frontier model (Opus 5.5, Fable, Sol or Hy4), which reads the code, spots the bug and plans the fix. When the plan is ready, the decision model hands over to the efficient model (Hy4 Flash, DeepSeek Flash or Sonnet), which writes the fix, runs the tests and finishes the job. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 with Opus 5.5 handing over to Hy4 Flash, the frontier model takes about 35% of the turns and 99% of the cost; the efficient model takes about 65% of the turns and 1% of the cost.
